findings.issue: Angled «está escribiendo» quotes; es style guide sets “ ” (angled only for an editorial register). Also 'escribiendo … mientras escribes … Lo que escribes' repeated the verb three times.
findings.before: … ven una breve línea «está escribiendo» mientras escribes. …
findings.after: … ven una breve línea “está escribiendo” mientras redactas. …

notes: Catalogue audit only: no rendered-fit or native-render claim. Mechanical checks above were executed by scratch build.py in the auditor session; findings are the auditor's linguistic judgement against glossary + style guide.
